capabilities.target: platform-resolved owner-private vault-pm roots or one explicit portable-import source
capabilities.justification: Loads exact configuration, owner state, bootstrap generations, encrypted immutable repository objects, or one bounded encrypted portable artifact through audited adapters.
Persists atomic configuration, crash-resumable owner journals, signed bootstraps, and encrypted immutable repository objects during initialization and item mutation.

capabilities.target: platform-resolved owner-private vault-pm roots or one explicit portable-export destination
capabilities.justification: Creates missing private roots and first-generation durable records through the local host and storage adapters, or one create-new already-encrypted portable artifact selected by the user.
Supplies advisory generation-zero and item mutation timestamps.

VLT-PM48. Resolves the running vault-pm binary's path so `agent start` can re-execute it as the detached `agent run-foreground` process; the fork and exec themselves are performed by rust/vault-pm-agent-host.

justification: Product composition package; terminal, entropy, and local-agent socket/process capabilities remain delegated to rust/vault-pm-cli-host and rust/vault-pm-agent-host respectively.
